title: bpf_tracing.h requires __TARGET_ARCH_* for register access
question: Does reading syscall or function arguments through PT_REGS require an explicit per-architecture define, forcing per-arch object files?
pass_means: Compilation fails without __TARGET_ARCH_* and succeeds with the correct one for this machine. One BPF object per architecture is required for programs that touch registers.
fail_means: Either the header compiled without an arch define, or the correct define did not compile. Both would contradict the documented libbpf behaviour and deserve investigation.
